image_description: A tall, wooden bookcase with five shelves filled with various books. To the right of the bookcase stands a thin, metallic floor lamp or stand with a vertical pole and a U-shaped base. The background is plain white.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly a tall, vertical rectangle, significantly taller than it is wide, matching the standard bookcase silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tall rectangular frame with horizontal divisions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structure consists of two vertical side panels and multiple horizontal shelf boards creating distinct levels.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bilateral symmetry with open front displaying books and objects.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frame itself is symmetric. The front is open (no doors), and the contents (books) are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Multiple horizontal shelves spaced evenly from top to bottom.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There are exactly 5 horizontal shelves including the bottom panel, spaced at regular intervals.
Adjustability is an internal mechanical feature (pins/holes) not clearly visible or verifiable from this exterior view.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture and color indicate a wood or wood-laminate construction with a finished surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Books are clearly visible on all shelves, and there are no doors obstructing the view.
The surface appears finished/smooth. While 'decorative hardware' like knobs is absent, the finish quality meets the criteria.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the metal stand/lamp on the right
artifact_observations.reasoning: The U-shaped base of the metal stand appears slightly warped and lacks clear physical grounding or thickness consistency compared to the vertical pole.

artifact_observations.location: Books on the second shelf from top
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some books appear to merge slightly into each other or the shelf background, lacking sharp individual boundaries.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a generic shelf or cabinet.
To verify the 3D structure of the shelves and ensure the metal stand has valid spatial grounding.
To check if individual books are distinct entities or if they suffer from fusion/melting artifacts.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and correctness of text on book spines, a known failure point for AI images.

focus_areas: Legibility of text on book spines
Structural integrity and straightness of vertical side panels
Physical plausibility of the metal stand's base
Separation between individual books on shelves
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the book spines. Even if the classifier identifies the object as a bookcase, severe text gibberish should lower the artifact score. Also, verify if the metal stand on the right is structurally sound or if it exhibits melting/warping at the base.
